thread:
zoe (Finance): Heads-up: Maply Feb invoice looks like roughly 1.01M embedding units billed, but customer telemetry and our consumer totals show ~505.5k. Opening thread for reconciliation.

kyle (Billing Ops): please paste the metering query and the route. Is this only /v1/embeddings? Any unusual schema migrations or deployments in that window?

zoe (Finance): query: ```SELECT SUM(embedding_count) FROM metering.events WHERE customer_id='cust_maply' AND date BETWEEN '2026-02-01' AND '2026-02-28' AND route='/v1/embeddings'; -- 1010043``` consumer pipeline: processed_embeddings_total=505523

anita (SRE): I ran a quick grep across deploy logs. We had the metering-schema migration (v1->v2) deployed 2026-02-10 04:22 UTC that enabled a compatibility writer for 2h while partners switched. The compatibility writer intentionally emitted both old_record and new_record for the same logical request to ease rollbacks. Example ingest log: ```[2026-02-10T04:22:03Z] meter-writer INFO request_id=req-77 event_id=evt-9b old_schema_written=true new_schema_written=true``` That would create two metering.events rows per request (old_format + v2_format).

mike (Platform): Correct. The intent was to emit both formats only for internal verification, but a feature-flag misfire caused compatibility mode to be ON for several customers including cust_maply. We missed a targeted opt-out. This duplication is bounded to 2026-02-10 04:22 -> 06:30 UTC.

kyle (Billing Ops): good find. We'll need to compute duplicates by matching on event_id / request_id and the migration window. Proposed steps: 1) snapshot ledger, 2) dry-run dedupe to compute duplicate_units where event_id appears twice (old + new) for same request_id in the timeframe, 3) export CSV of duplicate_event_ids, 4) post credit memo (negative line) for duplicate_units. Dry-run SQL sketch: ```WITH dup AS (SELECT event_id, COUNT(*) c, SUM(embedding_count) s FROM metering.events WHERE customer_id='cust_maply' AND date BETWEEN '2026-02-10T04:00:00Z' AND '2026-02-10T07:00:00Z' GROUP BY event_id HAVING COUNT(*)>1) SELECT SUM(s) duplicate_units FROM dup;```

liz (Acct Mgmt): I touched base with Maply. They noticed higher billing and flagged us earlier today. They're fine with a correction and would appreciate the audit CSV and a short note about the root cause and steps we're taking so they can justify it internally.

ez oe (Finance): (typo) also need accounting guidance: should this be a Feb P&L non-recurring adjustment?

metering-bot: Dry-run job scheduled: dedupe-migration-cust_maply (dry-run) queued by kyle. job_id=mf-20260210-pt1 ETA=20m.

anita (SRE): I'll run the dry-run and attach the CSV with fields: event_id, request_id, original_timestamp, embedding_count, schema_version_tags. Note: because old/new records were both written, some requests have slight differences in embedding_count due to rounding between serializers; we'll include both rows in CSV for Finance reconciliation.

kyle (Billing Ops): For posting the credit memo, Finance approval needed. Zoe, can you provisionally approve up to 520k units? We estimate duplicate_units ~= billed - consumer = 504,520 but we'll confirm with dry-run. Also request that the credit memo include metadata: adjustment_reason="compat_schema_double_write" and link to internal incident INC-20260210-schema-compat.

zoe (Finance): provisional approve up to 525k units. Conditions: must have dry-run CSV, list of event_ids, and a billing-adjustments ticket created. Please tag adjustment as non-recurring in P&L notes. Also include a short text field in metadata: "explanation": "schema migration compatibility writer emitted duplicate metering rows for a subset of customers".

mike (Platform): we'll flip the feature-flag to disable compatibility write for remaining customers and add a targeted rollforward script to remove double-writes at source (for audit) to avoid touching downstream ledger until ops confirms.

kyle (Billing Ops): ack. I'll run dry-run, upload CSV to BILL-1775123, and draft the credit memo with the requested metadata. Target post date: 2026-03-07 EOD after Finance sign-off.

metering-bot: Job mf-20260210-pt1 started (dry-run). Will post results in this thread when complete.

liz (Acct Mgmt): I'll prepare a customer note template that explains the duplication, the credit, and the preventive steps. Will hold send until credit posts unless Maply asks earlier.

anita (SRE): dry-run complete: duplicate_units (sum) = 503,824. exporting CSV now to BILL-1775123. There are ~120k event_ids duplicated, most duplicated exactly twice.

kyle (Billing Ops): uploading CSV and audit rows to billing ticket. Draft credit memo ready with metadata adjustment_reason and explanation. Asking Finance to confirm posting.

zoe (Finance): confirm posting credit for 503,824 embedding units. Record as non-recurring Feb adjustment. Please include the CSV in the ticket and add link to INC-20260210-schema-compat in memo. Approved to post.

kyle (Billing Ops): posting credit now and creating negative line item. Will update invoice and notify accounting. Posting done; credit_memo_id=CM-20260307-998.

liz (Acct Mgmt): will send customer comms now that credit posted. Template includes CSV and a note that we disabled the compatibility writer and added a pre-commit check to prevent double writes.

metering-bot: Credit memo CM-20260307-998 posted and linked to BILL-1775123 by kyle. Thread closed pending accounting reconciliation.
